title: Bike Tour of Chicago's Lakefront Neighborhoods
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

This Chicago Bicycle tour is appropriate for all ages and fitness levels. Professional guides blend quality information, group interaction, and most of all, fun, to create an unforgettable Chicago experience. Bikes are provided. Child bikes, seats and tagalongs are available.
Storage for larger bags/items available for free
Please note: children must be strong, capable riders and be able to bike for 9 miles
TripAdvisor rated Bobby’s Bike Hike its highest-level Traveler’s Choice Award each year since 2002.
Chicago Bike Tour operates rain or shine, please dress appropriately. If extreme weather forces cancellation there will be options to change tours or refund.

Minimum numbers apply for the bike tour of Chicago. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation if there are not enough guests to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is the tour that made Bobby famous! Bobby’s Bike Hike is America’s longest-running city bicycle tour company, and has been repeatedly recognized for excellence by National Geographic, USA Today, The Associated Press, Conde Nast Traveler, and more! Bobby’s now offers over a dozen specialized tours, but The Lakefront Neighborhoods Chicago Bike Tour is what started it all. Join one of Bobby’s expert guides on this 3-hour bicycle tour through Chicago’s beautiful North Side Lakefront neighborhoods. See the ever-rising skyscrapers of Streeterville, the deluxe residential mansions of the Gold Coast, the cozy artists’ village of Old Town, and the rolling greenery of Lincoln Park. You’ll finish off with a cruise down the world-famous Lakefront Bike Trail, one of the most popular waterfront bike paths in the nation. This leisure-paced journey is sure to make memories that’ll last a lifetime! This Bicycle Tour of Chicago is kid-friendly and all equipment (bikes, helmets) is included.
